targets.authors: Hepp J, Lane SP, Carpenter RW, Niedtfeld I, Brown WC, Trull TJ
targets.title: Interpersonal Problems and Negative Affect in Borderline Personality and Depressive Disorders in Daily Life.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study sought to replicate these findings in a separate BPD sample and a community control group.
targets.outcome_quote: The present study replicated a study, which demonstrated positive associations of momentary hostility, sadness, and fear with rejection and disagreement in BPD individuals’ daily lives ( Hepp et al., 2017 ). All six positive associations at the momentary level (rejection/disagreement each predicting hostility/sadness/fear) were replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly characterize the study as replicated and report all six momentary associations replicated. Differences in the level of some group effects are discussed without an overall failure verdict.

reasoning: Separate BPD and community samples retest the explicitly named 2017 study. Other cited studies motivate the hypotheses and are not separate targets.
